entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Are you free today?[n]Can we meet?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: There's just so much we[n]can't talk about at school...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: By the way, I'm no longer a maid[n]but I'll still do your housework.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You must be tired from your trip to the[n]Metaverse. Maybe you should get some[n]rest today.
entries.uk: Ти, мабуть, утомився після вилазки[n]в Метавсесвіт. Може, сьогодні краще[n]відпочити.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You already assigned a task[n]to Kawakami.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's go make the call then.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Seems like Kawakami wants to meet[n]tonight. Should we call her with the[n]yellow phone as usual?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Nobody thinks you're alive at this point,[n]so it should be okay as long as you're[n]careful.
entries.uk: Зараз усі думають, що тебе вже нема,[n]тож усе має бути гаразд, якщо[n]будеш обережний.
